_comment: Skip and flake budget enforced by checkBudget.mjs in the CI e2e job. maxSkipped = the 7 known skip sites (smooth-zoom x4 conditional on EXT_color_buffer_float/SUM mips, gl4 lost-context x1, chart-reconstructed x2). The replay transport test runs unconditionally in the replay project, with its own recording-enabled stack. Any new skip fails the job until this file is changed with a reason. maxFlaky allows tests that pass on a CI retry; lower it as flakes are fixed.
